    album.title AS album_name,
    COUNT(track.track_id) AS track_count,
    SUM(track.milliseconds) AS total_duration_milliseconds
FROM 
    album

    track ON album.album_id = track.album_id
GROUP BY 
    album.album_id, album.title

    COUNT(track.track_id) > 20
